title: Surface elevation scale and status-pill component kit (Figma interactive variants)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a cohesive Figma kit that standardizes surface elevation, micro-layout density, and status-pill patterns across the Redwood Console. Deliverables include token definitions, responsive component variants, an interactive prototype for rollout and cost views, and a handoff page with usage guidance for engineers and PMs.
acceptance_criteria: Figma library published with named tokens and component variants
Accessibility contrast checks pass AA for all text sizes
Engineering-ready token export (JSON/CSV) linked from handoff
Prototype demonstrates 3 density breakpoints and 4 elevation levels
